{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm QA orders are absent
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check channel values again
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")

# Check if any other channel might be hidden
print(f"Channel counts:\n{df['channel'].value_counts()}")"}
